Follow Officer Chitaro's prompt and get medical supplies by bypassing the ministry paperwork.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak with Imperial Guard Rantoh about medical supplies.
* Take the medical supplies to Guardsman Pah.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
Head to the southern portion of Wajjun Bazaar, just outside [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter]], to find [[Imperial Guard Rantoh]], then head a bit north of him to find [[Guardsman Pah]]. If you have [[Seek out Brother Tosai]] active or the [[Chalice of Corruption]], there should be no fights involved.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Officer Chitaro'''
:''"I have told you that the Celestial Ministry cannot help you until you complete the proper forms. Look, if it will get you out of my hair...speak to '''Imperial Guard Rantoh'''. If there is anyone who might be able to provide supplies immediately, it is he. Now, go away."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll ask him.
|decline = I don't think so.
|ask = Please take your problems to '''Imperial Guard Rantoh'''. I do not have time for them. 
|indent = :: }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
'''Imperial Guard Rantoh'''
:''"The Celestial Ministry is passing the buck once again, is that what you are telling me? I hate to let them do it, but I cannot let the people suffer. Here, take these supplies. I wish I could do more."''

===Reward dialogue===
'''Guardsman Pah'''
:''"You have brought medical supplies! I am so relieved! Thank you so much. Your efforts today will save many lives."''

[[Category:Rewards Imperial Commendation]]

==Notes==
*This quest appears to be mutually exclusive with the [[Red Tape]] quest.
